mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as chargeOrderAmount, COUNT(*) as charge_order_cnt FROM tb_charge_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as withdrawOrderAmount, COUNT(*) as withdraw_order_cnt FROM tb_withdraw_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) as online_privilege_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_investment_record
AND order_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND order_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
) as privilege_cnt FROM tb_project

SELECT COUNT(*) as zc_cnt FROM tb_user
AND create_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(investment_amount), 0) AS xs_amount FROM tb_investment_record
AND order_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND order_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_column, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'charge' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalCharges, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'withdraw' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalWithdraws, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'investment' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalOrders FROM ( SELECT create_time as date_column, 'charge' as source, CASE WHEN state = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END as amount FROM tb_charge_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
UNION ALL
SELECT create_time as date_column, 'withdraw' as source, CASE WHEN state = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END as amount FROM tb_withdraw_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
UNION ALL
SELECT order_date as date_column, 'investment' as source, investment_amount as amount FROM tb_investment_record
AND order_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND order_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
) combined_data GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date_column, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_column, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'register' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as newRegisteredMembers, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'recharge' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as newRechargeMembers, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'order' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as rechargeOrderCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'signin' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as signInCount FROM (
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_column, 'register' as source, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tb_user
AND create_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_column, 'recharge' as source, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as cnt FROM tb_charge_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_column, 'order' as source, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tb_charge_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sign_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_column, 'signin' as source, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as cnt FROM tb_user_sign_in
AND sign_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND sign_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sign_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) combined_data GROUP BY date_column ORDER BY date_column

SELECT create_date as date_column, 'register' as source, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tb_user
AND create_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY YEAR(create_date), WEEK(create_date)
UNION ALL
SELECT create_time as date_column, 'recharge' as source, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as cnt FROM tb_charge_order

GROUP BY YEAR(create_time), WEEK(create_time)

SELECT sign_time as date_column, 'signin' as source, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as cnt FROM tb_user_sign_in

AND sign_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
